import socket

def _t():
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    with s:
        assert 'fd=%i' % s.fileno() in repr(s), ('assertIn', 'fd=%i' % s.fileno(), repr(s))
        assert 'family=%s' % socket.AF_INET in repr(s), ('assertIn', 'family=%s' % socket.AF_INET, repr(s))
        assert 'type=%s' % socket.SOCK_STREAM in repr(s), ('assertIn', 'type=%s' % socket.SOCK_STREAM, repr(s))
        assert 'proto=0' in repr(s), ('assertIn', 'proto=0', repr(s))
        assert 'raddr' not in repr(s), ('assertNotIn', 'raddr', repr(s))
        s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        assert 'laddr' in repr(s), ('assertIn', 'laddr', repr(s))
        assert str(s.getsockname()) in repr(s), ('assertIn', str(s.getsockname()), repr(s))
    assert '[closed]' in repr(s), ('assertIn', '[closed]', repr(s))
    assert 'laddr' not in repr(s), ('assertNotIn', 'laddr', repr(s))
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import socket

def _t():
    SOCK_NONBLOCK = getattr(socket, 'SOCK_NONBLOCK', 0)
    SOCK_CLOEXEC = getattr(socket, 'SOCK_CLOEXEC', 0)
    sock_type = socket.SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, sock_type) as s:
        assert s.type == socket.SOCK_STREAM, ('assertEqual', s.type, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        s.settimeout(1)
        assert s.type == socket.SOCK_STREAM, ('assertEqual', s.type, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        s.settimeout(0)
        assert s.type == socket.SOCK_STREAM, ('assertEqual', s.type, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        s.setblocking(True)
        assert s.type == socket.SOCK_STREAM, ('assertEqual', s.type, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        s.setblocking(False)
        assert s.type == socket.SOCK_STREAM, ('assertEqual', s.type, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import socket

def _t():
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    fd = sock.detach()
    unknown_family = max(socket.AddressFamily.__members__.values()) + 1
    unknown_type = max((kind for name, kind in socket.SocketKind.__members__.items() if name not in {'SOCK_NONBLOCK', 'SOCK_CLOEXEC'})) + 1
    with socket.socket(family=unknown_family, type=unknown_type, proto=23, fileno=fd) as s:
        assert s.family == unknown_family, ('assertEqual', s.family, unknown_family)
        assert s.type == unknown_type, ('assertEqual', s.type, unknown_type)
        assert s.proto in {0, 23}, ('assertIn', s.proto, {0, 23})
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:

else:
